summary: ER physician fell in the Little Bear area: injured ankle, broken ribs, lacerations, later suspected collapsed lung from labored breathing; he, his wife and two friends descended toward Lake Como; AVSAR hasty team deployed and Flight For Life airlifted him from Lake Como at ~2058 hours to the mountain exit
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR; Flight For Life
notes: AVSAR 2012 archive narrative; subject an ER doctor, injuries self-assessed; helmet credited for preventing head injury
